content.short: Mobile banking and remittances for migrant communities.
content.description: Majority is a US mobile banking service designed specifically for migrants and immigrant communities who are often underserved or excluded by traditional banks. For a simple membership fee, it offers an FDIC-insured account and debit card that can be opened using a foreign ID and without a US social security number, along with international money transfers, discounted global calling, and community perks tailored to particular diaspora groups. Majority focuses on the real needs of newcomers — sending remittances home, receiving pay, and building financial footing in a new country — bundling banking, remittances, and support into one app. By centering the migrant experience rather than treating it as an afterthought, Majority positions itself as the bank immigrants always needed.
content.meta: Majority is US mobile banking and remittances built for migrant communities. Discover Majority and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
